title: Add Skins page to admin portal with All/Sold/Unsold tabs
body:
## Summary

Adds a **Skins** page to the admin portal (under AUCTION section) that reads from the existing `dbo.skintable` in the database.

**Features:**
- Maps the `skintable` to a new `Skin` entity via `CatalogDbContext`
- New `GET /api/skins?filter=all|sold|unsold` endpoint that returns all skins with sold/unsold status
- Sold status determined by checking if the skin's box belongs to a catalog lot that has been sold (via `AuctionResult.SoldToBuyerId`)
- Admin page with summary cards (Total/Sold/Unsold counts) and tabs to filter the table
- Table shows: Box, Barcode, Farmer, Farm, Sales Type, Gender, Group, Size, Color, Quality, Clarity, Status badge

Also includes a `GET /api/diag/schema/{tableName}` diagnostic endpoint for inspecting table schemas.
